findings.title: Recovery discarded recomputed verification and state patch; RECEIPT_VALIDATED record not bound
findings.root_cause: reconcile_with_ledger called executor.verify() but passed only dict(receipt) to reconcile_in_flight_attempt; for a PREPARED intent the verification's state_patch was dropped and replaced by a synthetic {status, receipt}. For RECEIPT_VALIDATED, persisted validated_verification/validated_action_result were trusted without any binding to the receipt or patch, and the fresh verification was ignored.
findings.fix: durable_loop._recovery_binding (sha256 over identity+receipt+patch+verification+action) persisted with RECEIPT_VALIDATED; reconcile_in_flight_attempt(verification=, action_result=) recomputes binding, requires persisted verification to bind receipt+patch, requires fresh verification to agree, and applies a fresh patch only after state_patch_validator; orchestrator passes the recomputed verification.
findings.verification_evidence: 3 crash tests + 7 tamper/partial cases fail on d5013f6 and pass on fix; full suite has no new failures.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: recovery_binding is an unkeyed digest: a writer with full L3 WAL write access can forge a self-consistent record. That forgery is still rejected unless the recomputed verification (from the L5 ledger and the same verifier) agrees, so the L3 WAL stays unauthenticated (ASSUMPTION: the L5 ledger and verifier are trusted).

findings.title: Ledger fold trusted event identity fields instead of canonical derivation
findings.root_cause: verify_effect_ledger took the dispatch attempt_id from the event and checked it only against the projection, never recomputed effect_id from (contract, logical_operation_id, actor), never compared create-event contract/actor with the projection, ignored attempt_id on transition events, and silently skipped events with a foreign event_version.
findings.fix: _fold_effect_ledger recomputes the canonical effect_id and dispatch attempt_id; checks create-event contract_id/actor/permit_id/effect_type (and logical_operation_id when present); rejects identity-field substitution on any event; fails closed on mixed event versions. create_effect now records logical_operation_id in the create event. Older create events verify as VERIFIED_SEPARATE and are never backfilled.
findings.verification_evidence: 8 of 11 attack cases fail on d5013f6 (ordering_extra_dispatch, conflicting_outcome and forged_effect_id_event were already rejected); all 11 are CONFLICT after the fix.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: Legacy effects with no v2 create event stay UNKNOWN (LEGACY_UNVERIFIABLE) and need operator migration. VERIFIED_SEPARATE relies on the projection's logical_operation_id, which is authenticated only by the effect_id derivation (INFERRED to be sufficient: forging it requires a SHA-256 preimage).

findings.title: verify_effect_ledger mutated the store (implicit journal recovery/quarantine)
findings.root_cause: verify_effect_ledger called recover_pending(), which rolls forward, deletes staging and quarantines batches. The docstring claimed 'Read-only: never repairs' (CONFLICT between doc and code).
findings.fix: New mutation.inspect_pending (read-only, no lock) and inspect_effect_ledger returning VERIFIED/VERIFIED_SEPARATE/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT. Pending journal or quarantine => UNKNOWN. verify_effect_ledger wraps it and raises only on CONFLICT. The orchestrator calls recover_pending explicitly before verifying.
findings.verification_evidence: filesystem-integrity.json: byte/size/mtime-identical snapshots across 3 cases; mutating functions are monkeypatched to raise during verification.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: API change: callers that relied on verify_effect_ledger for implicit roll-forward must now call recover_pending. Only core/orchestrator.py did, and it was updated (FACT, grep of core/scripts/research).

findings.title: _block bypassed canonical persistence and left a stale continue_contract projection
findings.root_cause: _block and the binding-mismatch branch called store.save() directly, so the continue_contract projection kept the pre-block content and contradicted the BLOCKED canonical state.
findings.fix: _block persists via durable_loop._persist_state, which rebuilds the projection. If the builder fails, the projection is dropped and projection_error is recorded, so restart fails closed instead of reading a contradiction. The binding-mismatch path now uses _block.
findings.verification_evidence: 3 blocked/restart tests fail on d5013f6 and pass on fix. Adapter call count stays 1 across restarts; status never returns to RUNNING.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: StateStore.save atomicity is backend-specific (MemoryStateStore in tests); file-backed store crash atomicity is not re-verified here (UNKNOWN).

stack_findings.title: Migration: RECEIPT_VALIDATED intents persisted before this fix have no recovery_binding
stack_findings.detail: These are rejected (BLOCKED, RECONCILIATION_REJECTED) on restart rather than trusted, and need operator reconciliation. This is fail-closed by design.
